item.coloph: dbang gi don nges par brjod pa zhes bya ba/ slob dpon rgyal ba bzang po dpal sbas pa zhes bya bas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /ru lag rgyang gi gtsug lag khang du rgya gar gyi mkhan po a ba d+hU tI pa'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba dge slong shAkya brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o
